training.logged_gradient_semantics: gradient_norm and head/body fields are recorded identically on all six ranks and taken once from updates; local_LoRA_cotangent_norm is summarized separately over actual rank records, not called a global norm. Synchronization/clipping timing is to be interpreted from the owning implementation.
training.missing_error_breakdowns: No per-task or per-layer BA/FM errors are recorded in updates.jsonl or the six rank logs. logical_events contain task/video/query addressing only; memory entries contain feature-cache provenance/cost, not errors.
training.loss_scope: BA stage uses 36 conditions per update; joint uses four changing conditions and 112 queries. Window summaries are actual training-stream statistics, not a fixed held-out error curve.

limits: Only fixed1180 has new closed-loop rows; no BA1000 closed-loop comparison, adjacent stability or causal attribution to joint FM.
Training-domain closed-loop deficits and held deficits can be separated descriptively; loss curves do not identify the failed representational or optimization mechanism.
Seen U36 is a label-side projection diagnostic, not a deployable held-condition oracle.
